name: Roofing (reroof)
summary: Reroofs priced by the square from footprint, pitch, tear-off layers, waste, dump and permit.

items.label: Tear off 1 layer and dump
items.source: Default sections (index.html): main 1,800 sq ft at 6/12 + garage 400 sq ft at 4/12, x pitchFactor (calc.mjs) = 24.34 surface squares; tear-off 1 h/square, 1 layer, steep multiplier 1; dump $35/tear-off square

items.label: Install architectural shingles + underlayment
items.source: Install 1.8 h/square and ($140 material + $22 underlayment) per square, each on squares x (1 + 10% waste) (index.html defaults; MATERIAL_PRESETS 'Architectural asphalt')

specialistModels: Pitch-to-surface conversion per roof section, steep-slope labor multipliers above 6/12, multi-layer tear-off, and material presets from 3-tab to tile.
